title: Dynamic Toolgun Screen (Tools / Utility)
description:
Have you notice that the screen of the tool gun is just a dummy image? It shows an operating system interface but does not update at all. Well that's no longer the case, here we introduce "Dynamic Toolgun Screen" to make it looks alive.

The settings are available under [u]Spawn Menu -> Tools -> Render -> Dynamic Toolgun Screen[/u]
Also accessable at [u] Utilities > Dynamic Toolgun Screen > Settings [/u]

Young in limbs, in judgment old,
Your answer had not been inscrolled
--- William Shakespeare

Also compatible to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2806571951] Advanced Toolgun [/url]

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
This addon is client sided. 

The screen being rendered in front of the paper note is a feature, not a bug. It can be corrected using "dts_inspect_on_top 0"

[h2]Console commands[/h2]
[b]dts_tool_back[/b], [b]dts_tool_next[/b], [b]dts_tool_prev[/b], [b]dts_layout_next[/b], [b]dts_theme_next[/b], [b]dts_track[/b], [b]dts_untrack[/b], [b]dts_notify[/b], [b]dts_export[/b], [b]dts_import[/b], [b]dts_reset[/b], [b]dts_language_reload[/b], [b]dts_debug[/b]
